title: Elctron man
description: This mod adds a new mob, a new slug, as well as armor, a sword, and a block.
body:
A new Stra Mob is in the jungle.
It appears in groups, but beware because it's aggressive if you hit it.

When you kill it, it will give you a new item that you can use to craft armor, swords, and its special block.

Armor: Craft it just like you craft regular armor in Crafting Table.
When you wear the full set of armor, it will grant you speed. If you remove one piece of armor from the set, it will disappear in the effect.
The armor is slightly stronger than the diamond.

The sword: You can craft it using 1 stick and 2 of the elctron called electrons, combining them with 9 and speed 1.

The block: very useful as you can craft it by filling the crafting table with elctron. The useful part is XP, which raises you 8 levels. But be careful not to break it with a pickaxe weaker than iron; breaking it will give you less elctron!

.
